name: VG2GT
aliases: Voxel-Gaussian Splatting Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer
definition: A feed-forward, non-pixel-aligned 3DGS reconstruction framework that directly regresses geometrically accurate Gaussian scenes and camera parameters from an arbitrary number of unposed and uncalibrated images.
summary: VG2GT is a feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting framework that directly regresses geometrically accurate Gaussian primitives from unposed images using a multi-scale voxel module, avoiding pixel-aligned artifacts.
